name: 99517 · Anchorage, AK
findings: ZIP 99517 (Anchorage) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99517 (Anchorage) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 99517 (Anchorage) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
